feedback: Written before this candidate has raced; no outcome is claimed for it. Evidence from earlier iterations: iteration 2 (kp 4.0, kd 0.3, wheel_track 0.11, wheel_radius 0.035) overshot, with steering_oscillation 0.27 to 0.28 and control_effort about 8 to 8.5, and finished only 2 of 20 oval runs. Iterations 3 to 7 raised slalom progress each agility step (0.34, 0.43, 0.53, 0.94, then 15/20 finishes at iteration 7), with oval and s-bend completions held. Iteration 7 s-bend steering_oscillation reached 0.347, so the damping margin is now the constraint on further narrowing. Integration work: I hold kp at 3.8 because a narrower track already adds turn gain, and I raise kd to 0.65 to damp it. Next race, the change depends on the result. If slalom steering_oscillation or s-bend oscillation rises above about 0.36, the track narrowing has outrun the damping, so return wheel_track to 0.11 m. If slalom finishes stay at or below 15/20 while oscillation stays at or below 0.32 and max_error stays near 0.034, turn authority is still the limit and the next step is a further narrow track. If oval or s-bend completions fall below 20/20 and 18/20, the step has cost stability.
requested_changes: If slalom steering_oscillation stays at or below 0.32 and slalom finishes rise to 16/20 or more: try wheel_track 0.10 m, since iteration 6 to 7 showed slalom progress rising with each track narrowing while oscillation stayed near 0.30.

If s-bend steering_oscillation rises above about 0.36 (iteration 7 was 0.347) or slalom oscillation rises above 0.32: hold wheel_track at 0.11 m or return to 0.105 m with the Integrator's kd raised, since iteration 2 at 0.11 m with kp 4.0 overshot at 0.27 to 0.28 and iteration 7 showed s-bend oscillation rising.

If slalom off_track endings persist with max_error at or above 0.06 while oscillation is stable: set sensor_size to 0.016 so the outer sensors cover more of the 25 mm tape at the sharpest bends, since slalom line_loss_events are about 1.25 per run and sensing has not been tested at this footprint.
